title: Probing sub-nanosecond timing properties of micron-scale transition edge sensors via a parallel SQUID-semiconductor readout scheme
task: Sub-nanosecond timing characterization of micron-scale transition edge sensors via parallel SQUID-semiconductor readout
key_results: Timing jitter below 200 ps (versus several nanoseconds for conventional SQUID readout); achieved under high-photon-number irradiation
comments: The decoupling of energy measurement (SQUID) from timing measurement (HEMT) is elegant, but single-photon timing performance remains unexplored and is critical for quantum applications.

title: Optimization of Sn-alloyed BaZrS3 chalcogenide perovskite solar cells via charge transport layer engineering
task: Optimization of Sn-alloyed BaZrS3 chalcogenide perovskite solar cells via composition and charge transport layer co-design
key_results: Sn at x = 0.125 reduces bandgap to 1.48 eV and maximizes JSC; x = 0 with WO3/FeS2 yields 20.02% PCE; VOC temperature coefficient = −1.40 mV K−1 indicates thermal stability
comments: The composition-resolved transport layer optimization reveals important structure-property coupling, though the 20% PCE lags commercial Si and remains below optimized lead-based perovskites.
